sloka: चतुर्भिर् वेग सम्पन्नैः हयैः कान्चन भूषणैः ।मुख्यः पुष्य रथो युक्तः किम् न गच्चति ते अग्रतः ॥२-२६-१५॥
transliteration: caturbhir vega sampannaiḥ hayaiḥ kāncana bhūṣaṇaiḥ ।mukhyaḥ puṣya ratho yuktaḥ kim na gaccati te agrataḥ ॥2-26-15॥

translations.english: How is it that the chief ceremonial chariot, decorated with gold and harnessed by four galloping horses is not preceding you?
